svg.title: Constellation on the client: one knowledge graph replaces the file explorer, Milanote and Obsidian
svg.desc: A constellation of documents on a dark field. The focused document sits at the centre of its cluster, with linked notes orbiting it. Labels show the roles it replaces: the file explorer for browsing, a Milanote-style board for layout, and an Obsidian-style vault of wiki-linked Markdown. Vim-style keys move the focus, and the layout rearranges around the new centre.

g.text: Replaces the file explorer, Milanote and Obsidian
Vim-style keys move the centre. The cluster rearranges around it.
